newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps ease gently lower, except flat fuel.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps ease gently lower, except flat fuel.

text.p: European oil swaps were steady to softer on Friday in a thin end of week market.
Brent CFDs slipped by up to 10 cents while gasoline lost $1, naphtha lost $1 and heavy fuel and gas oil crack spreads were unchanged.
Dealers said screen crude's break through technical support triggering strong selling took the momentum out of the complex which had been trying to rebuild after recent losses.

June 23-27 CFDs fell to -35 cents against August Brent from -24 cents with June 30-July 4 down to -35 cents from -27. July 7-11 -34 cents from -30 cents while July 14-18 was put at -35 from -30 cents.
A June 23-27 CFD traded at -35 cents.
Heavy fuel was steady with July heard done around unchanged levels of $81.50 with August in contango by $1 and September ranged between $84/85.
Gasoline swaps were knocked $2-3 lower with July pegged around $178 from $181.50 and August at $179 from $181.75. A couple of July swaps were done at $180 and $180.50 earlier in the day.
Naphtha was about $1.50 softer with July slipping to $173.50 from $174.75. August swaps were $1 in contango with September stronger by $2-2.50 against July.
Gas oil crack spreads were quiet with 4Q at $4.40-$4.45, 1Q98 at $4.65 with 2Q98 at $4.10.
